test_title: PYST 5: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of the letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series will complete the series.

_ r _ s_ c r _ _ t _ r u _ t c _ u s _

options.text: c, t, u, u, s, c, r, s, t
s, r, t, c, u, t, u, s, c
c, u, t, u, s, c, s r, t
c, u, u, s, t, c, s, r, t

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _ r _ s _ c r _ _ t _ r u _ t c _ u s _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the options one by one:

**Option 1) c t u u s c r s t** → c r t s u c c r t t r u u t c c u s s

Option 2) s r t c u t u s c → s r r s s c c r t t r u u t c c u s s

Option 3) c u t u s c s r t → c r c s u c c r t t r u u t c c u s s

Option 4) c u u s t c s r t → c r u s u c c r t t r u u t c c u s s

So, correct sequence is c t u u s c r s t.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
